document_title: Global AI QA Documentation and Sign-Off Taxonomy
provenance: User-supplied specification expanded into illustrative artefact inventory. Not an exhaustive global legal checklist.
notes: The 150 ethical QA considerations remain a separate baseline; links will be populated only after row-level mapping.
ISO/IEC 5338 clause mapping is provisional and not a claim of access to the full licensed standard.
SR 26-2 replaces SR 11-7 and SR 21-8 and excludes generative/agentic AI from its scope; applicability remains risk-based.
EU AI Act Article 11/Annex IV and Article 72 should be evaluated for high-risk system roles and current commencement.
GDPR Article 17 does not demand universal deletion on retirement; lawful retention exceptions may apply.
Examples of responsible job roles are proposed, not mandatory titles.
